findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_current_offers · Private data: search_products · Public sink: resolve_purchase_request, compare_products · Destructive: search_products.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_current_offers · Private data: search_products · Public sink: resolve_purchase_request, compare_products · Destructive: search_products

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
